runner: Native headless Chrome via Playwright, channel chrome
method: Instrument WebGL2RenderingContext createProgram, first drawElements/drawArrays and first readPixels. Intervals are CPU wall time and include compilation, setup, draw submission and synchronization. Single diagnostic run, driver cache uncontrolled; not application startup, not a pure shader compiler or GPU timer, and not a portable frame-time budget. Cached program identity and pixel parity are checked by the probe.
